assumptions.choice: Statistics begin when Backtrader makes EMA200 available.
assumptions.reason: The canonical convention requires relying on Backtrader automatic indicator minperiod.

assumptions.choice: A close equal to EMA200 is counted in Totaldays and its candle-direction total, but neither Totalabove nor Totalbelow.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines only strictly above and strictly below EMA200 conditions.

assumptions.choice: Overall categories use Totaldays as denominator; above/below directional categories use Totalabove/Totalbelow respectively.
assumptions.reason: This presents each directional breakdown as a percentage of its corresponding EMA-position category.

assumptions.choice: The summary report is exposed as self.report after stop().
assumptions.reason: The environment prohibits top-level execution and prints.
